scope: Linux GUI activation, camera brightness and preview retention; focused resource ownership audit, not a whole-project leak certification.
live_session: No running Blent instance was signalled, stopped, restarted, reconfigured or replaced. No live ADB endpoint, camera, display or microphone was accessed. Nothing installed or pushed.

regressions.T1449: Entry admission regression failed with unconditional startup (two callbacks instead of one), before adding admission logic. Final cross-process and actual executable Xvfb regressions verify one original window; queue, error, unwind and 64 reuse cycles retain no descriptors.
regressions.T1451: Permanent weak-reference/texture-count regression failed before Panel::stop cleared its preview and passed afterwards.

ownership.activation: One kernel-bound abstract datagram socket per canonical private runtime. Main retains its Rc outside run_gui until original media/thread cleanup returns or unwinds; the window borrows an Rc. Secondary socket is scoped to notification. At most 32 datagrams are consumed per frame; each message has a five-byte receive buffer. Kernel bounds queued requests. No worker, path unlink or stale lock is introduced. Drop closes each owned fd exactly once; rebinding is tested after return/error/unwind.
ownership.brightness: Decoder owns one scalar adjustment state inside its frame pool. At most 4096 center samples and a stack 256-byte LUT; no allocation or retained borrow per frame. Existing 2..16 pool slots plus one discard frame remain the funded pixel bound, each <=1920*1080*3/2 bytes. Arc::get_mut grants exclusive mutation before publication; retained reader slots are never changed. Partial read/cancellation does not publish a frame; dropping pool releases only its own references. Native decoder and output workers retain their existing original-completion fences.
ownership.preview: Stop replaces the cache immediately, releasing its one thumbnail Arc and egui TextureHandle even while the camera tab is hidden. The permanent test observes weak-reference expiration and one fewer owned texture; repeating Stop releases nothing twice.
ownership.conditional_cleanup: Native eventual cleanup assumes admitted workers/processes eventually produce original completion. Unknown cleanup remains owned; elapsed deadlines and logical completion do not authorize reuse. Existing tests cover held native writes, decoder cancellation, controller loss, failure, panic and original thread/TLS settlement.

validation.windows: blent-config and blent-gui --all-targets GNU Windows check passes; compilation only, no native Windows acceptance
validation.format: cargo fmt --all -- --check and git diff --check pass

limits: No physical-camera visual acceptance in the owner’s current lighting during the call.
Automatic brightness meters the central region, not detected faces; it changes exported pixels rather than sensor exposure.
Activation applies to a newly started updated GUI; it cannot attach to an already-running old GUI. Native focus remains subject to compositor policy.
No whole-project leak, allocator-erasure, hardware-lifetime or Windows-runtime claim.
